# sigma_workspace (Resource)

Manages a Sigma workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_workspace" "example" {
  name          = "Analytics"
  no_duplicates = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Workspace name.

### Optional

- `no_duplicates` (Boolean) Whether Sigma should reject duplicate workspace names.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Workspace creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) ID of the member who created the workspace.
- `id` (String) Workspace ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Workspace update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) ID of the member who last updated the workspace.
- `url_id` (String) Base62 identifier used in Sigma workspace URLs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_workspace.example workspace-id
```
